title: IndusInd Avios Visa Infinite credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: An Avios Visa Infinite variant providing elevated Avios earn rates, global lounge access, and milestone perks for frequent international flyers.

benefitRows.name: Concierge
benefitRows.offer: Homecare services with fixed-hour personnel in major cities.|OPD appointment bookings.|Diagnostic test bookings across 100+ cities in India.|Healthcare packages covering various ailments and support needs.|Teleconsultation appointments with GPs and specialists.|Home quarantine programme packages.|Physiotherapy assistance at home in select cities.|Consultations and bookings with wellness experts.|Consultations and bookings with nutritionists.|Consultations and bookings with dieticians.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Call the dedicated concierge number provided with your premium credit card or access it via the IndusInd mobile app. Request assistance anytime for travel, dining, or lifestyle needs.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Travel Insurance Benefits of Lost Baggage: Rs 1 Lakh, Delayed Baggage: Rs 25,000, Loss of Passport: Rs 50,000, Loss of Ticket: Rs 25,000 and Missed Flight Connection: Rs 25,000
benefitRows.howToAvail: Contact IndusInd Bank's Priority Care at 1860 267 7777 or email priority.care@indusind.com
